const oldDrawMon359=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;

  const fx=(this.v359Attacks||[]).findLast(f=>f.end>now&&f.kind==='contact');
  if(fx&&this.ctx){const t=c359((now-fx.at)/fx.duration),move=Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*(fx.move?.type==='fighting'?.07:.18);
    const dx=fx.to[0]-fx.from[0],dy=fx.to[1]-fx.from[1];const xx=dx*move,yy=dy*move;

};
const oldDraw359=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;

};
